title: plan_ops__decompose_plan input
description: Heuristic whole-plan → decomposed-directory split. Reads a `## TASK-NNN:` plan markdown file and writes a sibling directory with `00_INDEX.json` + one `TASK-NNN_<slug>.md` per task (H3 sub-heading grammar).

plan_file.description: Path to the whole-plan markdown file to decompose

out_dir.description: Destination directory; default <file-parent>/<file-stem>/. Refuses to overwrite a non-empty existing directory unless --force is set.
